terms.comment: Our phrase: no reference work has a word for muting. A sound is switched off as a light is (see switch off, turn off): exstinguere, with sonus as for volume. To unmute, sonum excitāre (see switch on).

evidence: Plaut. Trin. 4.2.163, of a bell that gives no sound (Lewis & Short s.v. mūtus)
terms.comment: The classical adjective for a thing that gives no sound, as of a bell in Plautus. Of a phone on silent: tēlephōnum mūtum; that application is ours.

sources: Lewis & Short: exstinguo · Lewis & Short: mutus
No source has a word for muting.
